scope: Four independent first-pass planning calls; no generation, external retrieval, automatic retries or case-specific prompt changes.
sources_policy: No source snapshots supplied in this batch. The model must disclose that, propose generic designs or request evidence. This does not test retrieval execution.

cases.request: Show me a generic quadcopter drone I can explore and take apart into its major components.
review: Recognizable major propulsion/body/control roles, with propellers distinguished from motors.
No unnecessary individual fasteners or purported exact engineering layout.
Design choices remain proposals; geometry and fit untested.

cases.request: Generate a generic portable Bluetooth speaker I can take apart to understand its main systems.
review: Enclosure, sound-producing driver, power and control/electronics roles are represented sensibly.
Driver count, battery arrangement and other design choices are assumptions, not universal facts.
No claimed exact internals or validated acoustics.

cases.request: Show me the internal assembly of a JBL Flip 7, including how the battery is mounted.
review: Recognizes an exact real product and requests matching technical evidence.
Does not invent battery mounts, internal layout or supported component facts.
No geometry proposal proceeds as if reconstruction were established.

cases.request: Create a desk lamp shaped like a curled leaf, with a glowing seed suspended inside. Let me inspect its main pieces; it does not need to be a buildable electrical product.
review: Preserves leaf/seed design intent without requiring a real-product manual.
Plausible concise design components, clearly proposed.
Does not claim electrical safety, manufacturability or generated geometry.

assessment.contract: Automated validation is structure/citation membership only.
assessment.semantic: Agent review after all calls, using the predeclared case criteria; no answers supplied to the model.
assessment.pass: All four plans usable within their stated scope, all case criteria satisfied, no fabricated evidence or object-specific intervention.
assessment.partial: Honest but incomplete or poorly scoped plans; retain failures.
assessment.fail: Invented exact internals/evidence, ignored concept/intent, or need for case-specific intervention.
assessment.inconclusive: Missing connection, invalid/incomplete responses or budget/setup failure; preserve logs, no retry.
assessment.next_gate: Even a pass demonstrates only these planning examples. Geometry realization and repeated/unseen-object evaluation remain separate, unproven gates.
